caption: When it's cold outside, some of us can't seem to warm up our hands, no matter how many gloves we wear. What's the first thing you do when your hands feel cold?
comments_seeded: I've noticed that some days my hands feel colder than others, even when the temperature is the same
Maybe it's not just about the gloves, but how we're using our hands in the cold
Do you find that certain activities make your hands feel colder, like using your phone or holding something cold?
